annotations.title: What moved in the agent record

description: What moved in the agent record, across every agent, since a date. The counterparty check answers what is true about one address NOW; this answers what changed, for all of them, which is the question anybody holding a list asks next. One row per FIELD that moved, not per address: an agent whose dealings and concentration both moved is two facts, and folding them would make you diff the answer to work out what was meant. Roughly one agent in five moves on an ordinary day; how many are tracked is a denominator on the answer rather than a number frozen here. A day with no row for an address is a day it did not move, never a day nobody looked. The record began on a date and `from` says which: asking for anything earlier answers from there rather than pretending nothing happened. Needs a key and the agents.changes capability.

address.description: One address, where you want its movement rather than everybody’s.

limit.description: Default 1,000, maximum 5,000. Read `capped` before concluding you have it all.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page when `capped` is true: the previous offset plus the rows it returned. Default 0.

since.description: An ISO date, such as 2026-10-01. The last seven days if you leave it out.

name: agent_changes

capped.description: TRUE where the page came back full, so ask again with an `offset`; FALSE means nothing moved after these rows in the window asked for, so the feed is complete rather than merely begun. A cap is not a count.

count.description: Rows IN THIS ANSWER, which is one per field that moved and not one per agent. Where `capped` is true it is the page size and not the total, so it is a floor on how much moved and never the whole of it.

from.description: The first day held at all. There is nothing before it because the feed began when it began.

items.description: address, day, field, was, now, and the path of that agent’s full check.

limits.description: What this answer cannot tell you. Quote it with the numbers.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

since.description: The day this answer starts from, read back so a clamp is visible.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: What moved in the agent record
